newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Perdigao rated hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Perdigao rated hold.

text.p: Brazilian investment bank Banco Omega said in a report it has rated local food company and meat processor Perdigao as a hold.
-- It said it estimates the company's earnings at 47.8 million reais in 1997 and 50.3 million reais in 1998, but it noted the company's stock already reflects the sector's risks.

-- It expects Perdigao's revenues to increase by 25 percent this year as the company launches 25 new products. It said the company plans to begin selling products in Argentina and sell Argentine fresh pasta in the domestic market as of July.
-- Perdigao preferred was up 3.77 percent at 2.20 reais earlier on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
